title: The UN fails to agree on rules regulating ‘killer robots’
slides: Why can't the UN stop killer robots?
Talks collapsed without a binding treaty
Autonomous weapons already deploy in conflicts
Your country may face no legal constraints
Push for national bans before deployment spreads
thread_text:
1. Killer Robots: No UN Fix

UN talks on autonomous weapons collapsed without a binding treaty, leaving a legal void as killer robots spread.

2. Treaty Talks Collapse

Nations failed to agree on limits for lethal autonomous systems, so there's no international law to stop them.

3. Robots Already Fighting

Autonomous weapons are deployed in current conflicts, making decisions without human control.

4. Your Country's Loophole

Without a treaty, many nations face no legal constraints on developing or using killer robots.

5. Push for National Bans

Demand your government support a ban on autonomous weapons before they become ubiquitous. Ask your representative: where do you stand?

instagram.caption:
UN talks on killer robots just collapsed without a treaty — so nothing in international law stops autonomous weapons from spreading.

Nations couldn't agree on limits for lethal autonomous systems. No binding rules means no legal ceiling.

These weapons are already deployed in real conflicts, picking targets without human control 🚨

Without a treaty, your country may face zero legal constraints on building or using them.

That legal void shapes the tools and defense debate you'll see in your feed for years.

Ask your representative one thing: where do you stand on a national ban on autonomous weapons? 🤖
